title: Smart Contract Handbook
subtitle: Interactive guide to Ethereum standards & DeFi protocols
description: Explore and understand Ethereum standards and DeFi protocols through interactive visualizations, live simulations, and clear explanations. From fungible tokens to cross-chain protocols, Smart Contract Handbook makes on-chain standards approachable for developers and learners alike.
featuresHeading: Everything you need to understand Ethereum standards

features.visualizationDesc: Understand complex contract interactions through clear, interactive flow diagrams that illustrate how each standard works under the hood.
features.simulationDesc: Step through real transactions and function calls in a sandboxed environment. Observe state changes and events as they happen.
features.multilingualDesc: Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish — making Ethereum standards accessible worldwide.
